products.name: Detail Condition Intake
products.product: A focused vehicle detailing condition and service authorization workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent mobile detailers and small multi-van detailing teams
products.problem: Package expectations, pre-existing condition, sensitive areas, add-ons, access, and customer priorities are often established through scattered texts.
products.valueProposition: Turns vehicle detailing condition and service authorization into a visible operating queue so every detailing appointment begins with a shared condition record and authorized service scope.
products.topic: vehicle detailing condition and service authorization
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets vehicle detailing condition and service authorization software, vehicle detailing condition and service authorization tracker, vehicle detailing condition and service authorization template, and vehicle detailing condition and service authorization checklist searches.

products.valueProposition: Turns mobile detailing location readiness into a visible operating queue so every mobile-detail stop is released with location resources and vehicle access confirmed or a recovery decision.
